meta.title: perf: Optimize team bookings query by using batch version
meta.body_summary: Switch team booking limit checks from per-user to batch database query to reduce queries and improve performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin switched team bookings queries to batch version; PR closed by agent after ~2.9 minutes with no maintainer interaction or review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 193 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume, concentrated in three backend files. It fits a typical small-scope performance PR that was closed immediately without merge due to agent self-close and zero maintainer engagement.

core_change_summary.description: In checkBookingLimits.ts and getBusyTimesFromLimits.ts, replaced single-user getAllAcceptedTeamBookingsOfUser with batch getAllAcceptedTeamBookingsOfUsers; also refactored getUserAvailability.ts to accept and handle multiple user IDs in a single call.
